title: The Eternal Son of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The eternal Son of God means that Jesus Christ did not begin to exist at Bethlehem. He is the Son who was with the Father before creation, shares divine glory, and came into the world to reveal God and redeem sinners.
summary: The eternal Son of God means that Jesus Christ did not begin to exist at Bethlehem. He is the Son who was with the Father before creation, shares divine glory, and came into the world to reveal God and redeem sinners.
christFocus: Jesus is the eternal Son sent by the Father for the salvation of His people. His incarnation is not the beginning of His existence, but the gracious entrance of the everlasting Son into human history.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture presents Jesus as existing before creation. The Word was with God and was God, and all things were made through Him. He is not part of what was made; He is the eternal Son through whom all things came into being.

The Son’s eternal glory is seen in His relationship with the Father. Jesus spoke of the glory He had with the Father before the world existed, showing that His life did not begin with His earthly birth.

The eternal Son truly entered time. He was born in Bethlehem, took on flesh, and lived among sinners, yet He did not cease to be the everlasting Son. His humility reveals the wonder of divine grace.

Because Jesus is the eternal Son, His saving work carries eternal worth. He does not merely point to God from below; He comes from the Father, reveals the Father, and brings His people into eternal life with God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
A Christ who began as a creature cannot fully reveal God or save sinners with divine power. The eternal Son of God gives believers confidence that the Savior is not weak, temporary, or dependent on creation.

This doctrine deepens worship. The One who humbled Himself for sinners is the One before whom angels worship and creation holds together. His grace is greater because His glory is eternal.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship Jesus as the eternal Son, not merely as a historical teacher or inspiring example. Trust that the One who entered your weakness is also the everlasting Lord who holds all things together and gives eternal life to all who believe in Him.
